text:
maya: FYI ran a regional sweep for continuous-batcher + q4 on mosaic-13b across us-east1 / apac-northeast1. APAC H100 is showing a long-tail latency spike when window < 6ms.

liam: can you paste the run id and the cmd?

maya: run id: rbw-sweep-2039. cmd: ./bench --model mosaic-13b-q4 --kernel auto --region apac-northeast1 --gpu h100 --batcher cont --window 3ms --max-tokens 2048 --clients 200

oren: what numbers? p50/p95/p99?

maya: results snippet:
```
us-east1 h100 window=3ms -> p50 12ms p95 45ms p99 120ms tps 110
apac-northeast1 h100 window=3ms -> p50 14ms p95 85ms p99 370ms tps 95
```

liam: whoa p99 370ms. did kernel choose fused_attention_v2? logs?

maya: kernel chosen: auto -> attention_v1 fallback for some sequences. log excerpt: "kernel_select: attention_v2 failed, fallback attention_v1; reason: workspace alloc fail at seq_len 1024"

sara: maybe memory fragmentation with q4+large seqs. try max_batch_tokens=4096 or bump window to 8ms. Also try forcing kernel=attention_v2 to see OOM vs fallback.

maya: started two quick reruns:
- rbw-2039-a: window=8ms, max_batch_tokens=2048
- rbw-2039-b: window=3ms, max_batch_tokens=4096, kernel=attention_v2

dev-bot: run rbw-2039-a completed: p99 130ms, tps 98
dev-bot: run rbw-2039-b failed: OOM on step 230, aborted

oren: that suggests larger window helps reduce p99 even if tps similar. probably batching coalesced better.

liam: also check KV cache eviction + prefix cache hits. If long-context chats, cache churn could spike allocations.

maya: added prefix_cache metrics: cache_hit 89% us, 55% apac for small windows. when window small, apac shows cache_hit drop to 42%.

sara: APAC region has higher variability network-wise -> more small requests forcing tiny batches. Idea: add min_batch_tokens floor or min_wait_ms to avoid micro-batches.

maya: agreed. next experiment: min_wait_ms=2ms + force kernel=attention_v2 with quant fallback disabled. kicking off.

oren: can you add a quick comparison command for ops team to size capacity? e.g., how many reserved gpus for 5k qps with p95 < 100ms.

maya: rough calc: at window=8ms apac h100 tps ~100 per GPU sustained for this model -> 5k qps requires 50 GPUs, add 20% buffer -> 60 GPUs. note: with q4 and proper kernel may reduce to ~40 GPUs.

liam: pinging infra to probe kernel alloc failures in apac, maybe CUDA driver mismatches across hosts.

sara: also file a regression ticket if quant fallback increases kernel fail rates. tag: #quant-onboard.

maya: thanks. will post final numbers when experiments finish. :thumbsup:
